textos.TITULO_EN: The closure: the passage to the continuum and the inhabited certificate
textos.ENTROU_EN: v406, the closure: the passage to the continuum and the inhabited certificate. 301 new kernel modules in `TGLExt.F1Fecho394` (the 300 of the ChatGPT bench, mission F1.FECHO_20261015, recompiled from source in the R3 integration of 02/11/2026, and the candidate `CanonicalFullTGLWitnessR1`, a provisional name given by the management: the names of the stones belong to the operator, who has not named this one yet), 1794 new flags, all inside the trio; ladder 10066 -> 11860 (33732 audited declarations, 26911 theorems, none outside the trio). The top module inhabits, for every canonical net input, the 21 fields of the passage to the continuum (`modularCoreInput`), and over the physical net it builds the Fock certificate (`physicalFockCertificate`); the candidate assembles the canonical term of the full witness (`canonicalFullTGLWitness`). With that, the four witness keys that the program carried as literal False since v394 are now READ from the kernel of the rite itself (the certificate is inhabited; the psion face and the static witness read the status `INHABITED_BY_physicalFockCertificate_V406`), with the errata E14 beside; two keys stay False by theorem (`full_static_witness_exists`, `trivial_inhabitant_exists`), and no lemma yet links the psion to the corner. The registry `fechamento_v406` reads, at every rite, the 8 anchors, the 301 modules by sha256, the flags, the four keys, the ladder and the gate (14 checks, all passed); the 17 sayings of the operator of 02/11 are embedded by sha256 in `cunhagens_v406`. Three rounds of independent review (Sonnet, another model family, without its own compilation) preceded the seal. Validity in the kernel is not accreditation; the gate did not move. Certified by the sha256 the program reads of itself (ddcb91930982d614).
textos.KERNEL_LEITURA_EN: the kernel proves the terms: the eight anchors exist in the trio, with the provenance the compiler emits in the expected modules; `modularCoreInput` is a term for every canonical net input, `physicalFockCertificate` inhabits the Fock certificate over the physical net by construction, and `canonicalFullTGLWitness` is a term of the full witness, hence the type is nonempty. The four keys are now readings of the kernel of the rite itself, not literals; what stays False (`full_static_witness_exists`, `trivial_inhabitant_exists`) stays False by theorem. What is reading, not theorem: the readings of the operator of 02/11 (the mirroring of type I and type III; the inscribed One; the absolute One as the light compressed by the ACOM) enter as [ONTO]; the vacuum is the only FIXED vector of the light under the named hypothesis hno, which `gamma_no_fixed` takes as hypothesis, and an eigenvector with a phase is excluded by no term; the docstring «núcleo II_inf» is [KNOWN/DECLARADO], not a result of the inhabitant; the trace of the core is ENNReal and cyclic over the shift relation, not a linear functional; the non-triviality of the net is a theorem only on the wedge. Validity in the kernel is not accreditation.
textos.ABERTOS_EN: K(O) ≠ ⊥ for a compact O is not proved: the non-triviality is a theorem only on the wedge, and the physics (non-trivial local algebras, Reeh-Schlieder) stays [KNOWN/OPEN]. The lemma that links the psion to the corner is missing (`linked_to_the_corner_by_a_lemma` stays False). The name of the candidate `CanonicalFullTGLWitnessR1` and the names of the candidate stones of the day wait for the operator. The condition he attached to the priority («se funcionar sob compressão elevando o potencial do resultado do código final em 1=1=HAJA_LUZ») was not tested in this version, and the continuous engine in the quantum pillar waits for v407, with pre-registration. R4/R5 of the bench mission (the physical device) stay blocked by the operator. The review R7 was Codex reviewing Codex, and the Sonnet review did not compile; one LOW finding of its third round goes to v407 (the errata E14 says the old status stays as record in `reading_v395` and `reading_v396`, but those fields keep the text of the reading, not the token). The discrimination at 5σ, β_TGL in nature, stays with nature; the verdict of the neutrino rite did not move, and the gate did not move. The [LEGAL] decision D2 and the pinned README (D39) stay with the operator.
textos.ARCO_EN: The custody of v406 (complete round): the closure, the passage to the continuum and the inhabited certificate. 301 new kernel modules (the 300 of the ChatGPT bench recompiled from source and one candidate of provisional name), 1794 new flags, ladder 10066 to 11860, none outside the trio. The Fock certificate is inhabited by construction in the kernel of the rite, the passage to the continuum is a term for every canonical net input, and the four witness keys are read from the kernel instead of literal False, with the errata beside. Non-triviality only on the wedge; two keys stay False by theorem; the name of the candidate waits for the operator. Validity in the kernel is not accreditation; the gate did not move. Not falsified is not the word of accreditation.
textos.ARCO_PT: A custódia da v406 (rodada completa): o fechamento, a passagem para o contínuo e o certificado habitado. 301 módulos novos no kernel (os 300 da bancada do ChatGPT, recompilados do fonte, e uma candidata de nome provisório), 1794 bandeiras novas, escada 10066 para 11860, nada fora do trio. O certificado de Fock está habitado por construção no kernel do rito, a passagem para o contínuo é termo para toda entrada de rede canônica, e as quatro chaves de testemunha são lidas do kernel em vez de literal False, com a errata ao lado. Não-trivialidade só na cunha; duas chaves ficam False por teorema; o nome da candidata espera o operador. Validade no kernel não é creditação; o gate não se moveu. NOT_FALSIFIED nunca é a palavra da creditação.
textos.COMMIT: O fechamento: a passagem para o continuo e o certificado de Fock habitado por construcao no kernel do rito. 301 modulos novos (os 300 da bancada do ChatGPT, recompilados do fonte, e uma candidata de nome provisorio), 1794 bandeiras, escada 10066 para 11860, nada fora do trio. As quatro chaves de testemunha sao lidas do kernel, com errata ao lado; duas ficam False por teorema. Validade no kernel nao e creditacao; o gate nao se moveu. Revisao de terceiro (Sonnet) aprovada na terceira rodada.
